_note: Component inventory of Kit Foundation V1 (siteId 6a7a804cfed7e6e46272c6b0). The stock kit ships exactly ONE component: 'Global Styles'. It has zero props and zero variants; its whole job is carrying two HtmlEmbed style blocks onto every page (instances on Home and Style Guide, first child of .page-wrapper). Everything else on the pages is plain elements — the kit is a class system, not a component library.

components.name: Global Styles
embed_style_overrides_summary: a, .w-input, .w-select, .w-tab-link, .w-nav-link, .w-nav-brand, .w-dropdown-* , .w-slider-arrow-* { color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit; font-size: inherit; }

.hide { display: none !important; } plus media queries: <=991px .hide,.hide-tablet; <=767px .hide-mobile-landscape; <=479px .hide-mobile (NOTE: embed says .hide-mobile, Webflow class is .hide-mobile-portrait — the Webflow class also sets display:none at tiny so both work)
DIRECTION RESETS (all !important): .margin-top/-right/-bottom/-left/-horizontal/-vertical and .padding-* same — each zeroes the OTHER sides so the paired size class only applies in that direction
embed_color_schemes_summary: .color-scheme-1 { } (empty: all sections point to Scheme 1 variables natively)

.color-scheme-2 .. .color-scheme-10 { --color-scheme-1--text: var(--color-scheme-N--text); same for --background, --foreground, --border, --accent } — wrapping a section in .color-scheme-N re-points every Scheme-1-bound style inside it
.w-slider-dot inherits var(--color-scheme-1--text) with 0.2/1 opacity, and !important overrides for .w-slider-nav-invert
